lines: 1. Rianra pui ram zing pui kandi khou hei,
He! Jisu rianra khang ping mak nga;
He! Gaipui ram tei mpat lou na ,
He! Kandimei nun khang khanglou kan the.
He ! kalvary ching khou,
Kazei keina ryanra khaeng mei,
Kazei man ne aniu pap khou rui kanlou mei.
He nthuk pui zei luang mei tei lum mei guai rui,
Kanpat mei ram khou guang tang ni the.
2. Thuk pui tingmik pat khang khuan bam lana
Thukpui sao pirun tei run lou na;
Kamei thei nimei kros puan lana;
He! Kalvary ching thang tei tat kan the.
3. Kanloumeipu theimei ching rukhou tei,
Meiguai guang kariuna zau bam e,
He nzian mei guai kapma huai e,
He kandi mei ta ping nga sa ngam mak.
4. Kros khou khang loumei ta zao ngam makge,
Kanloumei mak nga boukei kan the ;
He simon peter nthei kan the ,
He juda ban khou tei tilou kan the.
